newsitem.title: USA: Belmont sees some Q1 discounting moderating.
newsitem.headline: Belmont sees some Q1 discounting moderating.

text.p: Belmont Homes Inc said Thursday that it was disappointed with its first quarter results, but believes some of the discounting it saw in the first quarter is moderating.
"While industry conditions at the dealer level remain competitive, some of the discounting we saw during the first quarter appears to be moderating," the company said.
The maker of manufactured homes reported lower earnings of $0.09 a share in the first quarter on $52.1 million in sales, compared with year-ago earnings of $0.29 a share on $51.4 million in sales.
